simple.summary: דְּבוֹרָה (dᵉbôwrâh) means the bee (from its systematic instincts) First listed occurrence: Deut 1 44.

definitions.full: H1682. deborah I. דְּבוֺרָה noun feminine bee (compare Arabic , swarm of bees , Aramaic דַּבַּרְתָּא , Syriac ) Isa 7:18 ; plural דְּבֹרִים Deut 1:44 ; Judg 14:8 ; Psa 118:12 . Read also דְּבֹרוֺ its bees 1Sam 14:26 for דְּבַשׁ ᵑ0 compare ᵐ5 We Dr.
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) דְּבֹרָה ; from 1696 (in the sense of orderly motion);
